# Contributor Checklist

Use this checklist to ensure a smooth contribution process.

## Before Contributing
- [ ] Read the project README and guidelines
- [ ] Check existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] Create or comment on an issue to discuss your contribution
- [ ] Fork the repository
- [ ] Set up your development environment
- [ ] Read the coding style guide

## While Contributing
- [ ] Create a new branch for your changes
- [ ] Keep commits small and focused
- [ ] Write clear commit messages
- [ ] Follow existing code conventions
- [ ] Test your changes locally
- [ ] Update documentation if needed

## After Contributing
- [ ] Review your changes one final time
- [ ] Ensure all tests pass
- [ ] Push your branch to your fork
- [ ] Create a pull request with a clear description
- [ ] Link related issues in the PR
- [ ] Respond to review feedback promptly

## Quality Checklist
- [ ] Code compiles without errors
- [ ] No warnings or deprecation notices
- [ ] Consistent naming conventions
- [ ] Proper indentation and formatting
- [ ] Comments explain complex logic (if applicable)
- [ ] Documentation is accurate and complete
- [ ] No sensitive information or secrets included
